issues.evidence: The card combines 'Introducing Diffs in Agentic Office.' with the 22-word definition 'Every AI change across your model, memo and deck — shown in your own files, yours to accept or reject.' The timeline holds both for only 2.5 seconds.
issues.suggested_action: Keep the title and shorten the subtitle to 'Changes in your files. Accept or reject each one.' Hold the card for at least 3.5 seconds.

issues.evidence: The request, tracked changes and Changes-panel frames are visibly softer than the crisp graphics. At 00:56, 'Slide 2 · TextBox 23' is enlarged but blurred; the crop fills the output from a source region only 290 pixels wide.
issues.suggested_action: Use wider crops of the existing recording with crisp editorial captions quoting the key change. Replace the extreme punch-ins with higher-resolution captures when available, preserving the real UI text.

issues.evidence: The memo heading and changed paragraph extend beyond the right edge. The assumption replacement is cut off, and the table's FY26 outlook column is only partially visible.
issues.suggested_action: Reframe to contain the entire changed paragraph; use a separate table crop rather than showing a truncated paragraph and table together.

issues.evidence: The side-by-side slides leave the chart labels, old outlook box and replacement bullets small within the frame. The two slides and bottom caption must all be scanned during a three-second hold.
issues.suggested_action: Show each slide sequentially at a larger size, holding each for 2.5 seconds, or enlarge the comparison and remove incidental chart labels.

issues.evidence: The spreadsheet summary row visually runs 'Summary' into 'FY26', while the highlighted 8.5 cell and surrounding rows have clear spacing.
issues.suggested_action: Give the summary label a wider cell or merge the first two cells into one clearly spaced 'FY26 summary' label.

constraint_failures.rule: Every message must be large enough to read on a phone.
constraint_failures.evidence: The comparison places essential old-outlook text and replacement bullets inside small half-frame slides; these are substantially smaller than the main captions.

top_revision: Replace the extreme product-footage enlargements with wider, complete UI crops and crisp captions so the native changes remain legible without magnifying compression blur.
